prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; an immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant; a gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, voluminous curls balayage hair — wearing a skin-tight micro lehenga set of ultra-thin liquid-glossy dusty-rose silk charmeuse with gold embroidered borders, a tiny sleeveless choli top with thin straps, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the silk charmeuse fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and a micro flared lehenga skirt of the same silk charmeuse with a wide gold embroidered border at the hem and a small gold tassel cord tied at the top of her hip bones, a plain ultra-high slit cut up the left side from the hem to her hip bone, the hem ending just below her hip bones, her arms and legs bare, the silk charmeuse shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms and a small beauty mark beside her navel. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin silk charmeuse molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the gold embroidered borders and the tassel cord crisp against the liquid sheen, fine stretch lines and a soft sheen. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme — most extreme USSBBW silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of glossy dusty rose leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in dusty rose lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: heavy gold rings on every finger, sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme, thick opaque layers piled on: an opaque thick white eyeshadow smeared from the lash line up to the brows, thick white paint under the lower lashes, a very wide bright turquoise liner flaring far past the outer corners, extremely long clumped false lashes top and bottom, opaque glossy white lips.

Background: the wide granite courtyard of Gyeongbokgung Palace with a standard-height palace gate, low stone steps and a waist-high stone balustrade, empty of visitors, in clear sunny daylight, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
